_format: Champions League fixtures. There is no free, key-less feed for these, so they are kept here by hand. Add entries to "matches" and re-run `node tools/build-fixtures.mjs`.

_fields.time: HH:MM UK time, e.g. "20:00". Omit if not confirmed.
_fields.broadcaster: Optional. One of sky | tnt | amazon | bbc. Omit to let the UK rights rule decide (Tuesday league-phase night = one Amazon pick + TNT; every other match = TNT).
_fields.note: Optional free text shown under the match.
